shorts.title: The CIA Stole a Soviet Submarine 🔍 Case #8
shorts.description:
What if I told you the CIA built a fake mining ship to steal a Soviet submarine? Project Azorian: in 1974 the CIA used the Hughes Glomar Explorer, sold to the world as Howard Hughes's deep-sea mining ship, to lift part of the sunken Soviet submarine K-129 from about 16,500 feet down. It cost about $800 million. Asked about it, the CIA would 'neither confirm nor deny', and that answer is now called a Glomar response.
